Name: Sav's Raptors - Ostrich Replacer
Author: MM1991
Description:
Really, not raptors. Maniraptoriforme? Eats hay, tail is flexible, wrists do not pronate.

... Just like an ostrich.

Fantasy dino sprites by me, Sav, with a variety of recolors for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2274]More Animals[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url], etc. to replace or supplement ostrich skins.

[size=4][b]Install [/b][/size]
Instructions vary depending on your mod choice! But this is how you install with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2274]More Animals[/url] OR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url] (they aren't compatible):
1. Download and open Sav's folder up to them .pngs
2. Also open your "Stardew Valley>Mods>moreanimals>assets>skins" OR "Stardew Valley>Mods>adoptskin>assets>skins" 
3. Drag all .png sprites (or only the ones you like most) from Sav's folder into your "skins" folder.
4. Run game + SMAPI. If this is your first install of the reskin mod, or first time adding skins for this type of animal, they will be randomly assigned to animals in a preexisting save file I think. Yay!

﻿Process started with sketching overtop of vanilla ostrich spritesheet to align the animation cels without effort; haven't noticed any floating/missing pixels in play, but lmk.

Original art - please edit, also credit. Never drawn or edited sprites before? Some image editing programs have "select by color" tools, which is the second most useful thing to have when spriting with hand-picked colors. Most useful, I find, is a palette that lets you save little swatches. Better together, because I still end up with swatches that are only 2 values apart, somehow.
